Selection Tips
	1.	 Most foods on this list should be limited to 3 servings (as 
listed here) per day. Spread out the servings throughout the 
day. If you eat all 3 servings at once, it could raise your blood 
glucose level.
	2.	 Food and drink choices listed here without a serving size can 
be eaten whenever you like.
